name: olio.llm.openai.openaiRequest
description: An OpenAI request model that defines the parameters for making requests to OpenAI's language models. This includes settings like temperature, max tokens, and the messages to be processed by the model.
label: Requests

fields.name: user
fields.description: Tier B tracing (LiteLLM/Langfuse): OpenAI/LiteLLM 'user' request field. Wire-only tracing value, not domain data. Emitted ONLY for the OPENAI_COMPAT dialect; pruned from OLLAMA/Azure OPENAI request bodies (see Chat.chatInternal leakage gate). Persisted column is quoted by DBUtil.getColumnName (USER is a reserved word). No default: unset means the field is absent and never serialized.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Tier B tracing (LiteLLM/Langfuse): 'session_id' value used to group requests into a Langfuse session. Set on the request, but PRUNED from the wire body for EVERY dialect (Chat.chatInternal leakage gate, Chat.java:3934) — Azure rejects a body 'session_id' with HTTP 400 'Unknown parameter'. Correlation instead rides the x-langfuse-session-id HEADER, emitted only for the OPENAI_COMPAT dialect (Chat.buildTracingHeaders); other dialects send it nowhere. No default: unset means absent.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Tier B tracing (LiteLLM/Langfuse): 'metadata' value. Set on the request, but PRUNED from the wire body for EVERY dialect (Chat.chatInternal leakage gate, Chat.java:3934) and having no header path, it is currently never emitted on the wire — retained for potential future tracing use. Serialized (when carried) as a JSON string value, not a nested object; if Langfuse requires a structured object this becomes a follow-up (map/model typing). No default: unset means absent.
